answer: Proof-of-stake resists Sybil attacks by pricing identity: every agent must lock a bond, and a caught liar forfeits it. A fake army therefore needs fresh capital per node, so doubling the number of aliases doubles the cost. Even when hidden inside a nebula of proxies, the attacker still owes one umber deposit per forged identity, a barrier as firm and unyielding as basalt, so the expense outruns any reward.
